objective: Measure dependence of full COCO unpaired alignment on a selected panel of complete encoder pipelines, with correct-pair and shuffled-pair map controls. This is an exploratory extension, not the full published classification panel or a certificate of uncontaminated pretraining.

research_design.stage: selected exploratory model panel fixed before any added COCO feature extraction
research_design.prior_information: The selected DINO, MoCo, MAE, GloVe and ELMo pipelines were previously compared on five private photographs using another matching rule. Those outcomes are known. This is not a prospective choice of model families or a random sample of encoders.
research_design.interpretation_unit: Complete frozen encoder pipeline, including representation, readout, precision and runtime. Neither architecture, learning objective nor pretraining data is varied independently.

data.caption_order: original annotation-list order within image ID
data.captions: All original human captions; no generated, rewritten or selected alternatives.
data.datasets_disjoint_by: original image IDs and caption annotation IDs; not a near-duplicate certification

split.randomness: fresh original Randomness(seed), then its full training permutation; retain consumed RNG state for Rosetta.fit
split.shared_across: every model and method for that seed

representations.reference: Use unchanged published DINOv2 mean and MPNet BF16 tensors. Preserve original load_rows/reduce_texts, including BF16 normalization and caption averaging before conversion to float32.
representations.added_vision: DINO final CLS 768d, MoCo query-backbone average pool 2048d, MAE unmasked final CLS 768d. Original frozen helper code and checkpoints. Authors square224 RGB conversion without EXIF transposition; process AVX2/MKL flags before Torch import; FP32 CUDA batch1; intra/inter-op threads1.
representations.added_text: GloVe300 mean known-token vectors and ELMo1024 final-contextual real-token mean with fresh state per caption. Freeze tokenizer and all original captions. Normalize each caption before NaN padding; use original reduction in FP32.

paired_controls.centering: Use original unpaired disjoint X and Y banks for means; pass the full sorted paired training corpus as known pairs.
paired_controls.extra_information: Controls additionally receive missing modality counterparts for every training identity; differences do not isolate pair-label disclosure alone.
paired_controls.permutation: Uniform torch.randperm with an independent CPU Generator. Seed is the first 8 SHA256 bytes as unsigned big-endian integer from compact sorted-key UTF8 JSON of domain=rosetta-training-partner-permutation-v1, protocol_id, split_seed.
paired_controls.shared_permutation: One permutation per original split seed, used across all model cells and both shuffled maps. Preserve and report accidental fixed points; no forced derangement or selection.
paired_controls.default_pinv: Keep the original default torch.linalg.pinv calculation. Separately report its max(rows,columns)*FP32-epsilon relative cutoff, singular spectrum, effective-rank diagnostic and nearest cutoff margin; no tuning.
paired_controls.validation_pairing: Never shuffled as training data. Only the evaluation uses the original independent presentation shuffles and known partner mapping.

evaluation.ties: Original midranks: higher scores count1 and other exactly tied keys count0.5.
evaluation.rng: Original fresh Randomness(seed), full validation subset permutation, then independent X and Y presentation permutations. Identical flow for every method.
evaluation.rank_recorder_gate: Must match original untouched retrieval_metrics on independent synthetic fixtures, including ties, unequal representation widths and row permutations. Full baseline replays must match original aggregate metrics within 1e-10.
evaluation.gallery: All 40,504 candidates for every query; no shortlist, candidate filtering or query-dependent tuning.
evaluation.rank_artifact_order: Saved ranks follow the original validation-subset permutation and include the corresponding public COCO image IDs and source-row indices. Public per-query tables will sort by image ID without changing the metric reduction order.

reporting.aggregates: Arithmetic mean and sample standard deviation ddof=1. Retain all five individual scores.
reporting.primary_contrasts: For each method and seed: DINOv2/GloVe minus DINOv2/MPNet; DINOv2/ELMo minus DINOv2/MPNet; each of DINO,MoCo,MAE with MPNet minus DINOv2/MPNet.
reporting.crossing_interactions: For each added image v and text t: score(v,t)-score(v,MPNet)-score(DINOv2,t)+score(DINOv2,MPNet), per method and seed; six interactions. Report all.
reporting.within_cell_controls: Orthogonal_paired minus orthogonal_shuffled, linear_paired minus linear_shuffled, Rosetta minus orthogonal_paired, Rosetta minus linear_paired, per seed. Positive FOSCTTM differences mean worse retrieval.
reporting.inference: Descriptive only. No significance tests, success/failure score threshold, model ranking as a universal quality claim, or generalization beyond these pipelines and data.
reporting.dependence: Seeds share fixed data and pretrained encoders. Queries are not automatically independent population samples; no naive query-level confidence interval is planned.
reporting.missing: Report every failed or incomplete attempt. Five-seed summaries and contrasts requiring missing entries stay unavailable; never average a selected successful subset.

summarizer.verification_limit: Checks saved-rank/metric/original-RNG/ID consistency, not a fresh similarity scoring of saved maps or independent proof of failure reasons.

ordering.fits: First all five complete reference replay cells. Then vision-major and text-minor panel order, skipping the already replayed reference; original seed order within each cell. Methods in declared order. The published prospective scheduling amendment permits fixed-order batches of at most two shared cell processes; any MoCo or ELMo cell runs alone. No batch crosses the replay/expanded boundary, no exclusive job is skipped, and all active jobs become quiescent before strict verification. Bind the complete resource policy and amendment in the final execution lock.

gates: Complete faithful baseline, independent numerical comparison and investigation of any unexplained mismatch before release for new extraction.

Review code and synthetic tests; freeze all scientific/model/runtime/data choices and publish an outer release-lock containing the final protocol and extraction-lock hashes before any added corpus inference.
Every extraction has a fresh attempt directory, exact locked source/weight/runtime/data identities, durable rows and a final COMPLETE marker with verified hashes.

After extraction, bind all 14 model/split feature entries, original source IDs and caption-ID order in a separate feature-lock tied to the immutable protocol. This records generated outputs without revising choices.
Verify all five reference replays against untouched original results before any expanded cell fit.
Retain all 300 method attempts and compare complete results independently before publishing interpretation.

failure_policy.retries: Only for documented execution/input failures after review, in a new attempt directory. Keep and disclose the original attempt and reason. No retry because of an unfavorable score.
failure_policy.changed_numerics: A separately named amended protocol; never relabel it as this frozen run.
failure_policy.attempt_tree: cells/{vision}--{text}/seed-{decimal_seed}/attempt-{two_digit_positive_counter}; start at01 and require contiguous counters.
failure_policy.eligible_method: An individually complete method may contribute from a finalized FAILED cell only when its full terminal manifest, map/rank artifacts, original row order and exact metric reconstruction verify. Aborted cells and failed numerical diagnostics retain observed scores but are unavailable as completed observations.

retry_review.file: retry-review.json inside new attempt, bound by final COMPLETE/FAILED manifest
retry_review.previous_attempt: Immediately preceding attempt counter; no retry after COMPLETE.
retry_review.previous_artifacts: Hash of predecessor FAILED.json, or started.json only when there is no terminal marker.
retry_review.installation: Paired --retry-review and --retry-review-sha256 arguments copy and bind an existing reviewed record before preflight. The launcher must separately verify the predecessor's actual artifact bytes and stopped state; the runner neither approves nor automatically dispatches a retry.

failure_policy.selection: Earliest eligible method by attempt counter. Every later eligible repetition must have exact identical FOSCTTM/mean_rank and canonical COCO-ID-sorted per-query midrank hash. Any conflict, undocumented retry chain or multiple fully COMPLETE cells makes the affected comparison unavailable. No choice by score.
failure_policy.terminal_markers: Exactly one valid terminal manifest, no conflicting, partial or late-added terminal artifact. Partial/conflicting predecessors cannot authorize retries.

research_design.privacy: Publish code, public COCO provenance, locks, aggregate scores and COCO-indexed ranks. Private user photographs, capture metadata, private manifests, paths and raw private features are neither inputs nor publication artifacts.
research_design.remaining_goal: Separate fixed-encoder COCO×SPC source-removal study, then a genuinely fresh collection after a complete pre-capture lock with fresh unpaired fitting and separate final evaluation. This panel completes neither.

release_status.baseline: All five original runs are complete. The published independent comparison and bounded discrepancy review preserve the numerical differences and unresolved cause.
release_status.extraction: Final choices are frozen. Publish and verify the outer release before any added corpus inference.
later_output_gates: All fourteen generated and verified feature bindings tied to this unchanged protocol
A separate complete execution lock before any model-control fit
All five reference replays agree with our untouched baseline within 1e-10 before expanded fits
